newsitem.title: USA: Global Ocean names Vassilis Gazis CFO.
newsitem.headline: Global Ocean names Vassilis Gazis CFO.

text.p: Global Ocean Carriers Ltd said Friday that Vassilis Gazis was appointed chief financial officer and George Saroglou was appointed chief operating officer.
Both are employees of the Sovereign Navigation Corp, a statement from Global Ocean said.
The company said James Fairbairn, previously CFO, has assumed the title of investor relations director.

The company said no dividend was declared during the first half of 1996. But the company said it is now in a stronger position and is exploring the possibility of reinstating a dividend in 1997, "assuming that no adverse events occur."
